hey wht is this about
This is **SHG**, a command-line tool for simplifying Capacitor Android development. It helps you: - Set up Capacitor Android projects - Run live reload with `shg dev` - Build APKs/AABs - Deploy to phones/emulators - Manage plugins and devices - View Android logs - Diagnose environment issues - Bump app versions The repository also contains a React/Vite documentation website in `web/`. The main CLI code is in `src/`.
